english.title: Aid abet recipient to dishonestly fail give prompt notification of change in claimants circumstances
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), aided, abetted, counselled or procured **(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..),

(A)_[he]_
(B)_[she]_

being the recipient of a benefit, payment or advantage, namely **(..SPECIFY THE BENEFIT / PAYMENT / ADVANTAGE..), under **(..SPECIFY THE PROVISION OF SOCIAL SECURITY LEGISLATION..), in a case where a change of circumstances under section 111A(1C) of the Social Security Administration Act 1992 applied and knowing that the change affected the entitlement of the claimant, namely **(..SPECIFY THE NAME OF THE CLAIMANT..), to that

(C)_[benefit,]_
(D)_[payment,]_
(E)_[advantage,]_

an entitlement in respect of which the recipient had a right to receive payments, dishonestly failed to give a prompt notification to

(F)_[the Department for Work and Pensions]_
(G)_[a local authority, namely **(.. SPECIFY THE AUTHORITY..)]_

of a change in circumstances that the recipient knew would affect the claimants entitlement, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PARTICULARS OF CHANGES OF CIRCUMSTANCES..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 111A(1D) and (3) of the Social Security Administration Act 1992 and section 8 of the Accessories and Abettors Act 1861.

welsh.welshoffencetitle: Helpu / annog derbynnydd i fethu, yn anonest, rhoi gwybod ar unwaith am newid yn amgylchiadau'r hawlydd
welsh.welshstandardoffencewording:
Ar **(..SPECIFY DATE..) yn **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), bu ichi helpu, annog, cynghori neu beri i **(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..), yr oedd

(A)_[ef]_
(B)_[hi]_

yn derbyn budd-dal, taliad neu fantais, sef **(..SPECIFY THE BENEFIT / PAYMENT / ADVANTAGE..), dan **(..SPECIFY THE PROVISION OF SOCIAL SECURITY LEGISLATION..), mewn achos pan oedd newid mewn amgylchiadau dan adran 111A(1C) Deddf Gweinyddu Nawdd Cymdeithasol 1992 yn berthnasol, a chan wybod y byddai'r newid yn effeithio ar hawl yr hawlydd, sef **(..SPECIFY THE NAME OF THE CLAIMANT..), i'r

(A)_[budd-dal hwnnw]_
(B)_[taliad hwnnw]_
(C)_[fantais honno]_

yr oedd gan y derbynnydd hawl i dderbyn taliadau mewn perthynas ag ef, bu ichi, yn anonest, fethu rhoi gwybod ar unwaith

(D)_[i'r Adran Gwaith a Phensiynau]_
(E)_[i awdurdod lleol, sef **(..SPECIFY THE AUTHORITY..)]_

am newid mewn amgylchiadau y gwyddai'r derbynnydd fyddai'n effeithio ar hawl yr hawlydd, sef **(..SPECIFY THE PARTICULARS OF CHANGES OF CIRCUMSTANCES..)
welsh.welshlegislation: Yn groes i adran 111A(1D) a (3) Deddf Gweinyddu Nawdd Cymdeithasol 1992 ac adran 8 Deddf Affeithwyr ac Ategwyr 1861.

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: Six months imprisonment and/or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
INDICTMENT: Seven years imprisonment and/or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
